analyst_view.overall: Celta (27th, 3 points) host Bournemouth (2nd, 12 points from four wins) at Balaidos. Bournemouth under Marco Rose keep winning, the latest 2-0 against Nottingham Forest, but Alex Toth and Juanlu Sanchez are out and Julian Araujo is unlikely (all in the numbers' missing list); Rose has said Alex Scott will start one of the Forest, Celta and Fulham games and Junior Kroupi is pushing to start, so some rotation is likely. Celta lost 2-1 at Real Madrid on Sunday and have won once in five; striker Borja Iglesias (soleus tear since mid-October) and Miguel Roman are still not ready and Carl Starfelt is close but waiting on tests, none of them in the numbers' missing list. Both sides play again on Sunday (Celta v Villarreal, Bournemouth at Fulham), and no referee is named yet. I keep a small lean lower on goals for Celta's blunt attack without Iglesias; the rest stays with the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals, 1.2 for Celta and 1.8 for Bournemouth, and already trim Celta for scoring only 4 in their last 6 (-4.2%). Borja Iglesias, their main striker, is still out with a calf (soleus) tear and is not in the missing list, and Bournemouth may rotate a little with Fulham on Sunday; since much of his absence already shows in Celta's recent form, I only go mildly lower, to about 2.9.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.4 corners, split fairly evenly. Bournemouth's direct, wide play and Celta's wing-backs both produce corners, and recent corner form is already in the numbers, so possible rotation on either side does not clearly change this. I stay at about 8.4.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards and already lower Bournemouth for being booked less lately (-5.2%). No referee is named yet; Yoel Lago's yellow-card ban is for Celta's league game, not this one, and nothing suggests a heated match, so I stay at about 3.7.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.1 shots and already raise Celta for shooting a lot lately (+8.3%), even if few go in. Possible Bournemouth rotation (Scott's minutes managed, Kroupi pushing to start) changes faces more than volume, so I stay at about 26.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.8 on target and already cut Celta's share for poor accuracy (-9.6%), which partly reflects playing without Iglesias. Bournemouth's in-form forward line, led by Evanilson, keeps their side of it up, so I stay at about 8.8.
